quality.note: Escape cancels a List heading drag in the chooser, keeping selection and unsaved column order; main-window route is list-column-drag-applies-on-release (superset), so only chooser Escape routing is unique

message: the portal chooser opens in List mode
the chooser lists the fixture files
a file is selected before dragging a heading
Escape cancels the heading drag, not the entire chooser
heading cancellation preserves the file selection and saved column order in the chooser
another heading drag can commit after the previous one was cancelled
a subsequent successful heading drag also preserves the file selection
